visual.general_description: Scanned audiometry report with a pure tone audiogram grid, a symbol legend and a speech audiometry table.
visual.detailed_description: Scanned audiometry report page. A PURE TONE audiogram grid is headed by column labels 125, 250, 500, 1K, 2K, 4K and 8K and row labels from -10 to 120 in steps of 10. A grey legend box at the upper right is headed Right and Left and lists symbol pairs AC (O and X), Masked AC (triangle and square), bc (< and >), Masked bc ([ and ]), MCL (M and M), UCL (m and m), SF (S and S) and SF-A (A and A). Two connected symbol series are drawn: a series of six circles joined by line segments and a series of six X marks joined by line segments. Six > symbols and four [ symbols are also drawn; the first two [ symbols carry small arrow marks and two > symbols are joined by a short horizontal line. The circle line is relatively flat with small changes between neighbouring points. The X line is level over the first four points, then bends at the higher frequencies and ends close to the circle series at the right-most tick column. Below the grid, the text Transducer: Headphones is underlined, followed by the headings SPEECH & IMPEDANCE and SPEECH AUDIOMETRY and a table with columns SRT(dBHL), WDS(%), LEVEL(dBHL), MASK(dBHL), MCL(dBHL) and UCL(dBHL). The RIGHT row prints 65, 28 and 85 and the LEFT row prints 50, 84 and 80; the MASK, MCL and UCL cells are empty. No patient name, date or identifier text is visible.

visual.general_description: Grayscale axial head CT with enlarged ventricles, a linear shunt-like bright structure and arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale axial CT slice of the head with a bright skull rim and soft-tissue outline. The lateral ventricles are markedly enlarged and dark, with a butterfly-shaped anterior portion and two posterior horns extending toward the back of the image. A thin bright linear structure enters the image from the skull margin on the image-left side and reaches the ventricle at the point marked by a green arrow. Two red arrows point to the posterior portions of the ventricles. A yellow dashed measurement line with the yellow text 26 mm lies over brain tissue on the image-right side, and a partly cut-off white label ending in mm is printed at the right edge. The text Lossy and a letter P are printed at the bottom centre. No left or right orientation letters are visible. No patient name or identifier text is visible.
